title: Ratko Mladic, Murderous ‘Butcher of Bosnia,’ Dies at 83
summary_full: A general during the Balkan wars of the 1990s, he was convicted in the killing of some 8,000 Muslims at Srebrenica, Europe’s deadliest massacre since World War II.
